problem: The caption and aria text describe a constant-pressure path that ends at 0.25 m³, but the plotted series runs from 0.10 m³ to 0.30 m³, so the drawn line is longer than the process the chapter is about. A student reading the area from the graph would get 200 × 0.20 = 40 kJ, not the stated 30 kJ.
fix: Cut the series so the horizontal line starts at 0.10 m³ and stops at 0.25 m³ (keep the axis range 0.1–0.3 if you like), so the visible area matches 200 kPa × 0.15 m³ = 30 kJ.

problem: The symbol V is used for the potential difference of the capacitor, but everywhere else in the chapter V is volume and φ is potential difference. A student can read 'charged from 0 to V' as a volume.
fix: Rewrite Q8 as: 'A capacitor is charged from 0 to φ. Explain why W = ∫ φ dq gives ½Cφ², not Cφ².' and use φ/2 in the answer instead of V/2.
